tagline: Investing in flexible energy infrastructure to support the transition to net zero
hero_kpi_rationale: The operational portfolio in MW is the primary value driver, reflecting the actual storage capacity delivered and concrete deployment in the energy transition.

kpis.name: Operational Portfolio Size
kpis.explanation: Total capacity in megawatts (MW) of energy storage projects in operation.
kpis.description: The operational portfolio reached 945 MW at end of 2024, up 37% from 690 MW at end of 2023.
kpis.signal: Strong 37% growth over one year, indicating significant expansion.

kpis.name: Net Asset Value
kpis.explanation: Total value of the company's net assets after debt.
kpis.description: Net Asset Value declined from 740.1 M£ in 2023 to 622.2 M£ in 2024, due to lower projected revenue curves.
kpis.signal: Significant 15.9% decline, linked to downward revenue revisions.

kpis.name: Portfolio Revenues
kpis.description: Underlying revenues increased from 38.7 M£ in 2023 to 46.5 M£ in 2024.
kpis.signal: Robust revenue growth despite NAV decline.

kpis.name: Portfolio EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Gross operating profit from portfolio assets.
kpis.description: EBITDA increased from 25.8 M£ in 2023 to 29.1 M£ in 2024.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.description: Net debt increased from 66.3 M£ in 2023 to 110.5 M£ in 2024.

kpis.name: Net Debt to NAV Ratio
kpis.explanation: Financial leverage indicator, measuring debt relative to asset value.
kpis.description: The ratio increased from 9% in 2023 to 18% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Deterioration in financial health with the ratio doubling from 9% to 18%.

kpis.name: Average Battery Duration
kpis.explanation: Average time in hours the portfolio can deliver its maximum power output.
kpis.description: Average duration increased from 1.14h in 2023 to 1.43h in 2024, a rise of 25.4%.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in energy storage capacity.

kpis.name: NAV per Share
kpis.explanation: Net asset value per share, -1.5% over the semester
kpis.description: Net asset value per share, -1.5% over the semester

kpis.name: Operational Capacity (MW)
kpis.explanation: First UK BESS portfolio to exceed 1GW (Melksham, Shilton Lane, West Bradford)
kpis.description: First UK BESS portfolio to exceed 1GW (Melksham, Shilton Lane, West Bradford)

kpis.name: Hourly Revenue Rate
kpis.explanation: Average hourly revenue rate for 2h active assets, improved merchant backdrop
kpis.description: Average hourly revenue rate for 2h active assets, improved merchant backdrop

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the past 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 47.23 GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the past 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 1.529 bn GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio: Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the past 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 52.7% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capacity Under Tolling Contract
kpis.explanation: Power under fixed-price sale contract with Octopus Energy.
kpis.description: Tolling capacity increased from 310 MW at end of 2024 to 360 MW expected in April 2025.
kpis.signal: Reduction of merchant exposure through fixed-price tolling contracts.

risks.title: Underperformance of BESS Investments
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of the main risk table with strong language ('loss of value'). Trend increasing (2024 FY: High reducing vs 2022 FY: Low). Industry category carries moderate weight. Direct impact on portfolio valuation.

risks.title: Climate and Flooding Risks
risks.score_rationale: Climate risk explicitly addressed in TCFD with detailed probabilistic analyses and mitigation measures (elevation, drainage). Central position in report. Moderate language ('may be mitigated') but recognition of increasing physical climate impact on assets.

risks.title: Equipment Supplier Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Operational risk identified in main table with direct language ('may fail to provide adequate support'). Mitigation via alternative suppliers indicates risk recognition. Trend stable but structural to supply chain.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance and Safety
risks.score_rationale: Explicit operational risk with potential impact of 'curtailment of operations'. Moderate language but recognition that HSE/planning non-compliance could halt operations. Rigorous mitigation in place (testing, fire risk assessment).

risks.title: Carbon Methodology and Incomplete Reporting
risks.score_rationale: Reporting risk identified in TCFD section with explicit acknowledgment of methodological limitations ('does not account for lifecycle carbon impact'). Mid-report position. Technical language, no immediate urgency. Emerging trend with methodology development underway.

risks.title: Saturation of Ancillary Services Market
risks.score_rationale: Market risk identified in main table with direct revenue impact ('lower revenue streams'). Direct language on saturation. Trend stable but structural to UK market. Mitigation via revenue stream diversification.

risks.title: BESS Deployment Lag versus Renewable Energy
risks.score_rationale: Strategic risk explicitly identified ('rollout of BESS has lagged behind deployment of renewable energy'). Central position in report. Direct language on the lag. Trend stable but persistent. Impact on portfolio growth strategy.
